applies_to: coreav check verdicts through scripts/policy_check.py, against ffprobe 7.0.2 output mapped by scripts/policy_ref.py (from_ffprobe, from_ffprobe_matroska)

conditions.box headers: the stream's first sample entry is encv, enca, enct, encs, encm or encf (ISO/IEC 14496-12, 8.12)
conditions.ffprobe: names a codec for the stream

entries.basis: streams whose codec is not identified are dropped; only allowlisted inputs pass the gate

fields: rules of the subtitle kind, unidentified

conditions.box headers: another track's tref chap names the track; its handler is text, sbtl or subt
conditions.ffprobe: lists it as a data stream

entries.basis: every track is described by its handler and sample entry
the duration of a fragmented file comes from mehd

conditions.box headers: fragmented; the first track fragment of every listed stream has a tfdt decode time above 0 (ISO/IEC 14496-12, 8.8.12)
conditions.ffprobe: durations run from 0 to the stream's end

entries.basis: the stream duration is the media's length; docs/design/policy-check.md decision 8

conditions.ffprobe: every listed stream maps to an unidentified one

entries.basis: unidentified streams are dropped; the duration of a fragmented file comes from mehd or its identified streams; docs/design/policy-check.md decision 6 (fail closed)

conditions.box headers: not fragmented; a simple edit list or several edits CoreAV applies whose media edits add up to less than the mdhd duration
conditions.oracle: the stream's bit rate equals the btrt average or the stsz bytes over the mdhd duration (within 1 b/s)

entries.basis: the bit rate is the stored bytes over the stream duration; docs/design/edit-lists.md decision 5

conditions.ffprobe: names the stream's codec mpeg1video, mpeg2video, mpeg4, theora, mjpeg or ffv1 and gives a size

entries.basis: docs/design/policy-matroska.md decision 3 (fail closed: an unverified size is not a bound)

conditions.EBML elements: the TrackEntry has no DefaultDuration; a SimpleBlock or Block of the track is laced (RFC 9559 10.2)
conditions.ffprobe: names a codec other than opus

entries.basis: RFC 9559 10.3 (laced frames have no timestamp of their own); docs/design/policy-matroska.md decision 3 (fail closed)

conditions.ffprobe: names an audio or video codec other than opus; the span of its packet starts differs from the span of their ends

entries.basis: docs/design/policy-matroska.md decision 2 (the scan reads block and frame headers; a frame without BlockDuration or DefaultDuration ends where it starts)

conditions.EBML elements: the TrackEntry has a ContentEncoding other than header stripping, or more than one

entries.basis: docs/design/policy-matroska.md decision 3 (fail closed: frames that were not listed do not bound the duration)

fields: stream durations, bit rates and scanned sizes
rules max_seconds, max_bit_rate, max_width, max_height, max_pixels

conditions.EBML elements: bytes after the Segment's declared end, an EBML header or unknown element in the Segment, an element past its parent or the file, a second Info or Tracks, a BlockGroup with two Blocks, a block of an undefined track, an element whose length its schema type does not allow, or a string or binary longer than the audit allows (matroska_audit)

entries.basis: docs/design/policy-matroska.md decision 8 (the scan audits the structure; values that may miss frames are not bounds)
